name: The day before yesterday Rental Sales Report
query:
select 
    m.store_name as Store,
    t.external_type_name as Invoice_Type,
    MONTHNAME(t.invoice_date) as Month, 
    YEAR(t.invoice_date) as Year,
    sum(invoice_amount) as "Amount:Float:140", 
    sum(net_amount) as "Net_Amount:Float:140" 
from `tabRental Integration Sales` t
INNER JOIN `tabRental Integration Master` m ON t.store = m.name
where 
    t.invoice_date = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)
group by 
    m.store_name, 
    t.external_type_name, 
    YEAR(t.invoice_date), 
    MONTH(t.invoice_date)
report_name: The day before yesterday Rental Sales Report
